data.narrative:
Nordic Air Defence is a Seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Karl Rosander. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method, applied across 3 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables, yields a $400M implied valuation. The peer sample spans UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A), establishing a range of $125M to $1.0B. This method represents the sole triangulation approach applicable to the available data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median of $400M. The wide dispersion among peers ($125M to $1.0B) reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation for defense-tech companies, likely driven by differences in customer traction, technology maturity, and regulatory pathway clarity. The reliance on a single quantitative method and the limited peer sample size introduce meaningful estimation risk. Primary uncertainties include the target's specific revenue or customer metrics relative to comparables, and the extent to which Defense & Security dynamics at Seed stage mirror those of the identified peer set.
